title: Ted Mosby: Architect
novel:
Ted was an [[architect|architect]] — he had said it a thousand times. But lately, Robin had started [[yawning|yawn]] every time he mentioned [[cantilevers|cantilever]] or [[facades|facade]]. She was [[bored|bore]], and Ted could feel it like a [[papercut|papercut]] on his heart.

"Maybe I should [[switch|switch]] careers," he [[pondered|ponder]] one evening. Barney [[overheard|overhear]] and [[nearly spat|nearly spit]] out his drink. "Are you [[insane|insane]]? You're an architect! That's the third most [[impressive|impress]] job title after [[president|president]] and [[astronaut|astronaut]]!"

But the real problem was not Ted's job. The real problem was that Robin felt [[trapped|trap]] in a [[routine|routine]]. Date night every Wednesday, brunch every Sunday — their relationship had become as [[predictable|predict]] as a subway [[schedule|schedule]].

Ted decided to [[surprise|surprise]] her. He [[rented|rent]] a [[convertible|convertible]] and took her to a [[construction|construction]] site where one of his building [[designs|design]] was being built. "This is mine," he said, pointing at the [[steel|steel]] [[skeleton|skeleton]] rising against the sky. "One day, people will live here. They'll fall in love here. They'll start families here."

For the first time in weeks, Robin looked at him the way she had on that first night at MacLaren's. "That is actually kind of [[magnificent|magnificent]]," she admitted.

"I know," Ted said. "I'm an [[architect|architect]]."

yawn.en: to open your mouth wide and breathe deeply when tired or bored

cantilever.en: a long beam fixed at one end, used in architecture

facade.en: the front of a building; a false appearance

bore.en: to make someone feel tired and uninterested

papercut.cn: 纸割伤（比喻小但痛的伤害）
papercut.en: a small cut from paper that hurts more than expected

switch.en: to change from one thing to another

ponder.en: to think carefully about something for a long time

overhear.en: to hear someone say something without them knowing

nearly spit.en: almost sprayed liquid from one's mouth in surprise

impress.en: to make someone admire or respect you

president.en: the elected leader of a country

astronaut.en: a person trained to travel in a spacecraft

trap.en: to keep someone in an unpleasant situation they cannot escape

routine.en: the usual way you do things, which can become boring

predict.en: to say what will happen in the future

schedule.en: a list of times when things will happen

rent.en: to pay money to use something for a short time

convertible.en: a car with a roof that can be folded down

construction.en: the work of building something like a house or bridge

design.en: a plan or drawing showing what something will look like

steel.en: a strong metal used for building structures

skeleton.en: the basic bones that support a body or structure
